sources.title: Models | Kranium AI Docs
sources.snippet: Welcome to the 'Models' module of Kranium AI! This comprehensive module is designed to empower users to build, manage, train, and deploy machine learning (ML) and convolutional neural network (CNN) models using their datasets.

sources.title: Overview | Kranium AI Docs
sources.snippet: The 'Models' module in Kranium AI is a powerful tool that democratizes the process of creating and deploying AI models. By providing an intuitive interface, robust features, and seamless integration capabilities, it enables users across various domains to harness the power of machine learning and deep learning.
